title: Account Manager / State /Team Handling
description:
Job Title: Account Manager (Night Shift)/ Government Project /VMS Specilaist/ Handling Team
Company: InterSources Inc.
Location: Remote
Okay to use own laptop  
 Apply nidhi@intersourcesinc.com
 Responsibilities and Duties: We are looking for an experienced  Account Manager / Team Lead US IT Staffing  who can independently manage client requirements, lead a team of US IT Recruiters, and actively participate in  hands-on sourcing, screening, and submission of candidates . The ideal candidate must have strong experience working with  MSP/VMS clients , handling VMS portals, managing recruiters, sourcing quality candidates, and ensuring timely fulfillment of client requirements. Experience with platforms such as  Fieldglass, Beeline, or similar VMS tools  will be highly preferred.  Ability to demonstrate work experience related to US Staffing Recruiting Lifecycle (gathering requirements, candidate prospecting, candidate screening, candidate submission & follow-up, etc.)
Apply process-based recruiting techniques for screening candidates, send pre-screened candidates to the accounts manager, and coordinate scheduling interviews with the manager/stakeholders.
Collaborate with Accounts manager to understand the key skills, relevant experience, and objective to draft job requirements subsequently posting them on social media and job portals.
Clear understanding of the US Staffing processes/ Techniques W2/ 1099/ Corp-to-Corp/ H1 Transfers.
Strong in Active and Passive searches to source day-to-day requirements.
Proactive and Ability to work independently and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.
Recruiting candidates from social media and networking to get the best talent in the industry for the positions.
Follow up with the candidate in each stage and finally closing.
Understanding of common foreign national work authorizations for the United States- H1B, L1, EAD, TN, Green Card etc.
Should be good at sourcing the resumes from the different portals, Vendors, databank, employee references, networking, headhunting etc.
Ability to write Boolean queries and innovate search terms on commonly used job boards such as Dice, Monster, CareerBuilder, etc.
Uploading, Monitoring and maintaining Job Postings on Job Portals.
Conducting phone screens, including completing pre-qualifying questions and selling potential candidates on location, position, and company.
 Required Experience, Skills and Qualification: 
Relevant experience in US IT Staffing b/w 11-15 years or more.
Good understanding of technology and associated technical skill sets.
Excellent verbal & written English, interpersonal communication skills, negotiation skills, Understanding of US culture, job rules and regulations, and ethics.
Candidates working in BPO in US shift will also be preferred.
Must be willing to work in night shifts (EST or PST time zone).
Should have good knowledge and experience on working with MS Office, G-Suite.
Experience using ATS (Job Diva), nice to have
Experience working for Semiconductor, Electronics, Embedded, Product manufacturing companies (Ideal to have).
Experience in recruiting US Citizens, EADs and Green Card & H1B Holders.

Partner Success Specialist
description:
Role & responsibilities As a Partner Success Specialist, you will help build and grow Evynxs network of travel operators across India. Working closely with operators, guides, and experience providers, youll help them succeed on the platform while ensuring travellers receive reliable, high-quality experiences. This is a relationship-driven operational role where youll combine communication, problem-solving, and process improvement to strengthen both partner success and traveller trust. 
 Support new Operators through onboarding, verification, and activation on Evynx. Build strong working relationships with travel operators, guides, and other local experience providers. Coordinate Operator inputs including pricing, availability, inclusions, operational details, and other information required to activate and manage travel products. Help Operators understand Evynx processes, quality expectations, and platform workflows. Coordinate with Customer Success and internal teams to support enquiries, bookings, changes, and on-ground requirements. Track Operator responsiveness, service quality, and operational performance. 
 Preferred candidate profile Strong communication and relationship-management skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple Operators and manage follow-ups effectively. Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to handle day-to-day operational issues. Ability to work independently, take ownership, and manage multiple priorities. Comfortable working with digital tools, structured workflows, and data. Experience in partner success, vendor management, marketplace operations, account management, or a similar partner-facing role. Experience working with travel operators, guides, hotels, experiences, or other tourism businesses. Understanding of travel products, pricing, itineraries, and booking operations. Familiarity with CRM, partner-management, or marketplace tools. Proficiency in Hindi and English; additional Indian languages would be valuable. Degree or diploma in Travel & Tourism, Hospitality, Business Administration, or a related field. Experience in the travel, tourism, hospitality, or marketplace industry. Bachelors degree in any discipline. 
 Perks and benefits Help build Evynxs Travel operator network from an early stage. Work directly with travel operators and local experts across India. Shape the processes and standards that will define how Evynx works with its partners. Gain exposure across partnerships, marketplace operations, customer experience, and travel products.

Key Skills: Partner Management,Vendor Sourcing,Vendor Management,Partner Support,Vendor,Sourcing,Management
